title: Replay physical-ordinary-interchange against its pinned selected record (no scientific change)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Replay repair only. No scientific change and no new κ.** Before this change, `research/physical-ordinary-interchange` (jmbarrancoml, #2899) failed its registered replay on main with `working source drift: certificates/selected-result.json`. jwr404 flagged this in #5417. The frozen PR2809 loader inside `inputs/pr2809.tar` accepts only the two exact selected records that existed when the package was written, so every frontier promotion broke the replay.

After this change the replay passes again with identical receipts. The package now carries the exact record pinned at its base:
- That record (Git blob `b1fea0c9…`, sha256 `bb2eaa58…`) is vendored as `inputs/selected-result-pinned.json`.
- `source.py` serves it to the loader from a private temporary repository view. Every other declared input is copied unchanged from the working tree, and the loader and the PR2753 verifier still authenticate all of them.
- `SOURCES.json` now marks the record as `provenance`, and `VERIFY.json` drops it from the live inputs.

The archives, all checkers and `RESULT.json` are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

This is maintenance following #5410/#5417 (jwr404). #5417 fixes jwr404's own packages and names this one as blocked; it also blocks three of jwr404's packages that run this loader. Base is `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`. No other open PR touches this package.

## Validation

`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/physical-ordinary-interchange` was run locally. All eight registered commands pass and reproduce the stored `RESULT.json` digests:
- `setup`, `root` and `controls`, each in normal and `-O` mode;
- `binary`;
- `engine`.

The run used Windows 10 and Python 3.12. For that local run only, I used a small wrapper that makes relative `Path` strings use `/`. The frozen PR2753 verifier compares `str(path.relative_to(...))` with POSIX names, so it fails on Windows independently of this change. The wrapper is not part of the PR.

On this slow laptop CPU the engine suite takes 650–700 s, which is above its 600 s allowance. VALIDATION.md records 165.53 s on the author's machine, so hosted CI is the decisive timing check. Hosted [run 40094446546](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40094446546) passed plan and this package's registered replay (engine 241.2 s). Five dependent packages that this change re-triggers fail with their own pre-existing `working source drift: certificates/selected-result.json`; they fail identically on main and are not touched here: encoded-body-depth-borrowing, high-cube-b1-fit-bridge, ordinary-one-factor-stock, sealed-strict-root, unconditional-batched-crt.

`check_research_commit.py` passes. The second commit reuses, byte for byte, the `docs/ci-verification.md` navigation repair from #5420, because main still fails that shared onboarding test.

## Credit

The package is by jmbarrancoml (#2899) and its PR2809/PR2753 predecessors. jwr404 identified the drift in #5417. Mark (Matarener) with substantial Claude Code (Claude) assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

None justified. Any future selected-record change no longer affects this replay.
